name: stop-that-guy
description: Stop That Guy! — 3D multiplayer browser chase game (npm workspaces root)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run validate && npm run smoke
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stopthatguy/shared && npm run build --workspace @stopthatguy/world && npm run build --workspace @stopthatguy/simulation && npm run build --workspace @stopthatguy/client --workspace @stopthatguy/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && tsx --conditions=stopthatguy-source --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run test:assets && npm run test:environment && npm run test:characters
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser -w @stopthatguy/client && node scripts/assets/browser.mjs --dev && node scripts/assets/browser.mjs && node apps/client/src/camera/browser/acceptance.mjs --dev && node apps/client/src/camera/browser/acceptance.mjs && node apps/client/src/render/environment/browser.mjs && npm run test:characters:browser
